# EmptyState

The `EmptyState` component is used to communicate a zero-results condition or an empty state of an interface securely across all platforms.

- **Import:** `import { EmptyState, EmptyStateDensity } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Core
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; linked to its Figma component through Code Connect.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/components-emptystate--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import { SearchMd as Search } from "@kozmos-ds/icons";
import { Button, EmptyState, ThemeProvider } from "@kozmos-ds/react";

export function EmptyStateExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <div className="w-[360px] h-[400px] border rounded-container bg-card flex">
        <EmptyState
          title="No results found"
          icon={<Search className="h-8 w-8 text-muted-foreground" />}
          description={
            "We couldn't find any places matching your search. Please check your spelling or try another term."
          }
          action={<Button variant="outline">Clear Search</Button>}
        />
      </div>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## EmptyState

It forwards its ref to `HTMLDivElement`. Its props are `EmptyStateProps`, which extends `React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>`.

- `icon`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `title`: `string`, **required**.
- `description`: `string`, optional.
- `action`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `size`: `"default" | "compact"`, optional.

  How much room it takes.

  `default` fills its region and pads itself by 32, which is right when the
  empty state IS the screen. `compact` is for a slot that already draws a
  box around it — a result list's empty slot, a card, a panel section.

  Measured on the MAP-474 boards: a no-result state with an icon came to
  258px inside `POIResultList`, of which 48 was the slot's own padding
  (removed 2026-09-25) and 64 this component's. `compact` brings the same
  content to about 150 (GAP-009).

- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## EmptyStateDensity

Used by slots that draw their own box — see `POIResultList`.

Its props are `"default" | "compact" | undefined`.

- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it.
